content:
There have been long-standing rumours about a new Apple TV 4K, said to feature a more modern chip to support Apple Intelligence. But a new leak discovered by Aaron Perris suggests its chip will be more powerful than expected.

Code leaks indicate that the upcoming Apple TV 4K will feature an A19 or A19 Pro chip

We've been waiting for a new Apple TV 4K for quite a long time — longer than any period in the product's history.

There were originally rumours that a new model would launch in 2025, with evidence pointing to an A17 Pro chip. That chip is the current minimum requirement for supporting Apple Intelligence, so it made sense, and would also be a notable upgrade over the existing A15 Bionic.

But according to Aaron Perris, the new Apple TV 4K will feature a better chip than expected. He wrote:

We've found information about Apple's upcoming Apple TV model, AppleTV18,1

razmsu pinned comment

All I want is for the remote to make a sound so I can find it when it's lost. That's it. Please.

The '18,1' identifier is similar to that of last year's iPhone 17 lineup. Some iPhone 17 models use the A19 chip, while the iPhone Air and 17 Pro models use the A19 Pro.

Either chip would be a considerable upgrade for the Apple TV. But I'd guess the A19 Pro is more likely, as it's the only one that supports the most advanced Siri AI features.

Siri AI is expected to be one of the headline features of the new Apple TV 4K. Given how long it's been since a hardware update, I'd hope Apple wouldn't launch a new model only to immediately miss out on some AI features.

Are you planning to buy the new Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.
